scope: Native store controller dispatch, current offer and confirmation metadata

findings: Fixed send computes cost zero for freePurchase, otherwise quantity * item.Offer.price, then checks balance for non-real-money offers
Purchase path uses item.Offer (+0x108), not arbitrary AllOffers entry
Giftable item can route through recipient flow; do not bypass original UI
ShowBuyConfirmation alone does not promise a confirmation: base send also checks currency, threshold, freePurchase and other branches
Process request invokes requestConfirmed before subsequent submission call: callback is not settlement
Fixed purchase C includes tail-called base body; bounded listing defines actual function range

tests: current offer differs from AllOffers mock PASS
missing current offer remains null PASS
live original current offer and flags read
limitations: Final inventory settlement and durable submission protocol not implemented
